About me

I am a computer science MSc student, with a great interest in AI, embedded systems and compiler technology.

In my bachelor thesis, I developed a compiler for accelerating the execution time of a convolutional operation. The project was done in collaboration with the non-profit research organization FZI Forschungszentrum Informatik using the open-source compiler infrastructure MLIR. Here, I focused on domain specific hardware developed by M. Kirschner for his PhD thesis.

I live in Odense, Denmark with my girlfriend, cat and daughter. I enjoy spending time with my family, playing and watching football (most noteably Odense Boldklub).
